title: Social promises, dinners, and preparation costs
shortTitle: Social promises, dinners, and preparation costs
summary: Ordinary social invitations and arrangements can induce expenditures without an express discussion of legal enforcement.
notes: When does the context communicate an intended legal commitment? What role do the scale of preparation, words of assurance, and the relationship play? The notes also ask how a lawyer should identify relevant facts while avoiding manufacturing a client’s account.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 186–187. Open assigned page 186.
